name: Challenger (STS-7)
about: Challenger (STS-7) (1983-059A), a crewed vehicle (OV-099), launched 1983 Jun 18. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1983 Jun 20), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW15); its coordinates are written from memory
